_purpose: The records the loader counts with the first-year reports under rule M01 as the author extended it on 1 October 2026 (round 62, fourth cycle): a record whose own triangles hold underwriting years, none up to t-2, whatever its figure's route (run_analysis.no_mature_cohort). The paper's numerator (Equation severity) is development on underwriting years u <= t-2, and such a record has none; a prior-year figure it states is the development of younger cohorts. Each entry gives the record's triangle years, read by run_analysis.triangle_years from the imported record, and the filing's own statement of the syndicate's start: the words as they stand on the page (the text layer of the local filing; the extraction's OCR page cache for an image-only filing; the converted PDF for an HTML filing), the page (1-based in the file hashed, or in paged_file), the printed folio where one was read, and the file's sha256. missingness_check.py classifies a filing the loader skipped under M01 as structural only with an entry here whose triangle years are the record's; src/test_no_mature_cohort.py holds the loader's catch to these entries.

_measurement.rule: run_analysis.no_mature_cohort, from 'a lone model reading with no route, the readings disagreeing' to every route
_measurement.inputs: analysis a0d0127 (the extraction at 51bf5095 imported), its outputs regenerated: the loader run twice in one process on the same records, once with the rule before and once after, nothing else changed
_measurement.repeated: at the extraction's final, 2ee4007e (analysis 68edf96, its loader and partition rerun): the rule before against the rule as committed changes the same 11 decisions and no other

_records_the_rule_cannot_see.what: working-sample records whose own record holds no triangle year, so that the rule cannot read their age: read in the sample of 681 before the rule, and the same 25 in the 676 after it and in the 674 at the extraction's final, 2ee4007e (the records the rule and the final register take out of the sample all hold triangle years)
_records_the_rule_cannot_see.scan: each filing's text (its text layer, the OCR page cache for pages without one) searched for: began / begun / commenced / started / incepted / launched / formed / established / created / set up / incorporated / replacing / replaced, with the year t or t-1 (bare, 'YOA', 'year of account', '1 January') within 150 characters; 'first (full) (underwriting) year (of account / trading / operations)'; 'second (underwriting) year (of account)'; 'new syndicate', 'new entrant', 'newly formed', 'newly established'
_records_the_rule_cannot_see.found: one, and it is no new syndicate's: 5678/2014's live underwriting began in July 2014, which is t, in a syndicate formed for reinsurance to close business written in 2008-2010, whose reserves hold those older years (E4's reading, 1 October 2026). No other filing puts the syndicate's start in t or t-1: the hits are about other entities (a team, a class of business, binders, reinsurance programmes, service companies, another syndicate), a year of account's second year, or the FRS 102 transition. One more says when the syndicate began: 3334/2018 (it 'commenced underwriting in August 2006'). 3902/2022 has no hit; its 2018 filing puts its start in the 2017 year of account, at or before t-2.
